turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Both options are fantastic, so it really comes down to your visual preference rather than a difference in quality or durability! Both High Five and Low Tide feature the exact same waterproof, hardened real European white oak technology, GREENGUARD Gold non-toxic certification, and lifetime warranty.
The cheaper option ($5.59/sq ft High Five) is completely fine and high quality—it just uses a narrower 6-inch plank width. The extra $1.10/sq ft for Low Tide ($6.69/sq ft) pays strictly for the aesthetic upgrade of wider (8-inch) and longer (7-foot) planks, which can make a room feel larger and more open.
